title: Logos 29 opening: then the Son himself will be subjected
english: Twenty-ninth discourse. On “when all things are subjected, then the Son himself will be subjected.”
Future subjection is read without making the Son now lesser in nature than the Father.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
